steps.title: Configure Project Meta Information
steps.description: Create the app-meta.json file defining the app name 'Fifty Numbers' and package name 'com.fiftynumbers.app'.

steps.title: Define Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with target SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and Gradle 8.5 compatibility using native Android packages.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml file with correct package name com.fiftynumbers.app, Material Light theme, icon reference, and MainActivity registration.

steps.title: Design Main Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout containing a neat title banner, a card displaying selected number details, and a high-performance ListView for 1 to 50.

steps.title: Design List Item Layout
steps.description: Create list_item_number.xml representing a single row in the list, styled as a modern native card showing the number and its parity (Even/Odd).

steps.title: Implement Number Math Helper Methods
steps.description: Develop utility algorithms in MainActivity to determine if a number is prime, perfect square, and convert it to Roman numerals and binary.

steps.title: Implement Custom BaseAdapter
steps.description: Implement a custom list adapter in Java 8 compatible anonymous/inner classes to render numbers 1 through 50 with custom styling and labels.

steps.title: Handle Click Interactions
steps.description: Implement onItemClick actions to update the detail dashboard view at the top of MainActivity with full properties of the selected number.

steps.title: Set Default Selection
steps.description: Configure the onCreate logic to load and inspect number 1 by default on startup.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Check standard imports, replace any streams or lambda expressions with standard loops and nested classes to build successfully.

steps.title: Validate manifest configurations
steps.description: Double check AndroidManifest.xml namespace to avoid XML parse errors during the build.

steps.title: Building Fifty Numbers
steps.description: Perform build steps compiling Java 17 compatibility bytecode targets and generate the final debug APK.
